title: Fundamentals of Respiratory Care Research Quiz

questions.text: Even if a respiratory therapist never conducts a study, what is the minimum expectation regarding research?

answers.text: To become an educated consumer of medical research
To publish at least one paper per year
To serve on an Institutional Review Board

questions.text: A new RT student wants to eventually become a respiratory care scientist. According to the lesson, what is the single most helpful first step?

answers.text: Find a mentor experienced in conducting and publishing studies
Submit an abstract to a journal immediately

questions.text: What are the three basic missions of academic medicine?
In the R.A.C.E. stakeholder model, which group needs the ability to find, summarize, and present evidence for clinical activities?
What is the common skill that all research stakeholders must possess?

answers.text: The ability to read and critically evaluate published scientific reports
The ability to perform advanced statistical modeling
The ability to secure research funding
The ability to design medical devices

questions.text: Which search engine is described as the most popular and is a service of the U.S. National Library of Medicine?
Which resource is identified as the leading synthesized database?
A vendor loans an RT a new airway device for an inexpensive evaluation that does not involve human subjects. What is true about IRB approval?

answers.text: IRB approval is not required, because the IRB is required for studies of human subjects
IRB approval is always required for any RT research
IRB approval is required only because the device is new
IRB approval is required because the vendor donated equipment

questions.text: In the feasibility acronym M.A.D.S.A.K., what does the 'M' stand for?
How is a hypothesis defined in this lesson?

answers.text: A supposition or proposed explanation for an observation
A proven conclusion drawn from completed experiments
A condensed summary of a research paper
A statistical test used to compare proportions

questions.text: An investigator wants to compare the mean values of three different treatment groups. Which statistical test is appropriate?
Which statistical test is used to compare proportions?

answers.text: A chi-square or Fisher Exact test
